long: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent PNG blank modular backing for tall wide game buttons. Design a new stout gothic science-fiction iron plaque, hand inked game illustration with strong black outlines, flat painted shading, desaturated charcoal and dark teal centre, muted aged brass trim. Thick substantial height, horizontal aspect ratio 3:1. Angular stepped end caps with a small rivet and engraved gothic notch, no cloth ribbons, no skull. Centre 65 percent is an uninterrupted broad dark low-detail flat plate for runtime text. Top and bottom bronze border across that central area must be straight horizontal, constant thickness and height so the centre can tile horizontally. No repeating crosshatch or busy noise in the centre. Blank with NO text, no symbols. Front on, genuine transparent background outside plaque, closely frame it. Not photorealistic, not a 3D render.
menu: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent PNG blank main-menu button for a hand illustrated gothic science-fiction game. A distinctive wide substantial ceremonial obsidian plaque, horizontal aspect ratio about 4:1, chipped ink-black angular silhouette, aged bronze sculpted gothic bracket at each end, thin antique brass inner trim, tiny skull engraved in the left bracket. Restrained dark crimson accent recessed into side brackets only. Large quiet empty charcoal-black centre for two lines of runtime typography. Hand painted flat colour with expressive black ink outlines, readable bold silhouette, subtle worn edges, not photorealistic, not rendered metal, no ribbon tails. Symmetrical front view, genuine transparent background, closely cropped. NO lettering, words, arrows or watermark.
